The Sniper

A spam sniper buy/sell bot, trained on our own token's pools before it ever sees a mainnet. The run: 1,000 transactions per chain — 2,000 total — under hard gas quotas the runner cannot cross: 6.66666 test USDC on Arc, 0.00333 test ETH on Robinhood.

  1. ✓

    Deploy STEST on both chains · DONE — NOV 15

    Same address on Arc and Robinhood testnets, supply verified onchain on both.

  2. ✓

    Create both liquidity pools · DONE — NOV 15

    STEST/USDC on Arc, STEST/WETH on Robinhood. LP tokens stay in the burner wallet — never locked, never burned.

  3. ✓

    Test-remove 10% of the LP · PASSED — NOV 16

    Proof the money comes back before the run starts. Robinhood passed through the patched router; Arc's third-party router reverted, so Arc liquidity came out by direct pair burn instead — same result, tokens home.

  4. 4

    The 2,000-transaction run · UP NEXT

    Buys and sells against our own pools, inside the gas quotas. Liquidity removal is the final step of the run.

House rules for every run: testnet only · burner wallet only · gas estimated and shown before anything is sent · honeypot simulation before any buy · exact-amount approvals, never unlimited · the first live Arc swap still has to prove the third-party router — if it reverts, the Arc leg gets a different router.

DYOR

The culture of this build. Airdrop and reward hunting runs on one feed and three rules — and the rewards are a bonus. The point is the reps: sharpening onchain skill before the mainnet sniper launch.

The signal feed

Updates come from the Telegram channel @airdropfind ↗ (~513K subscribers), read hourly. The feed is uncurated — it has carried Ponzi-type schemes and “guaranteed airdrop” wording, and nothing is ever guaranteed. Every post gets verified before anything is touched.

Impersonator warning: @AirdropFindTeam is a different channel — not the source. Check the handle letter by letter.

The three rules

  • Verify, don't trust. Contract, source code, creator, holder distribution — read them yourself on the explorer before a single transaction.
  • Not your keys, not your coins. Agent wallets are MPC with tiny caps; the burner holds testnet value only; a seed phrase is never typed anywhere a stranger suggests.
  • Free or nothing. No subscriptions, no KYC, no paying to unlock an “airdrop.” If it costs real money or real identity, it's out.

Side quest · the Bitcoin Puzzle

Running

The famous 2015 puzzle is real and still open: 77 unsolved addresses holding ~903 BTC, re-verified onchain Nov 15, 2026. Two engines hunt from the VM — a random key scanner weighted by expected value, and a Pollard's Kangaroo solver working inside puzzle #140's range (one of only five with an exposed public key). It's a lottery ticket, not a plan — and if a key ever lands, the claim goes through a private relay, never the public mempool: solvers who broadcast in the open got robbed by bots in 2024 and 2025.
